title: ReceiptCheckpointV1
description: Signed checkpoint object for retention compaction. JCS ReceiptCheckpointV1, signed by the key active at checkpoint creation.

schema_version.description: Checkpoint schema version, always 1 for v1

key_id.description: Key ID that was active at checkpoint creation

cutoff_sequence.description: Decimal string of the sequence cutoff; rows strictly before are deleted

first_retained_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the first retained receipt after compaction

prefix_last_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the last receipt in the deleted prefix

last_deleted_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the actually last deleted receipt

head_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex hash of the chain head at checkpoint creation

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional milliseconds

canonical_checkpoint.description: Base64url-encoded canonical JCS bytes of the checkpoint object (without signature)

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (128 lowercase hex chars) over canonical_checkpoint
